slots.name: ripwire
slots.text:
# ripwire

`ripwire` maps this repository's code: ranked symbols for a task, callers,
callees, the tests that reach a symbol, and stack traces mapped to source.

    ripwire . --for="<the task in plain words>" --json   # what to read first
    ripwire . --callers=commit_prose --json             # who calls it
    ripwire . --affected=commit_prose                   # test files that reach it
    ripwire . --from-trace=- < trace.txt                # frames to file:line, innermost first
    ripwire . --at=src/app.rs:197                       # the definition enclosing a line

A symbol is a bare name, `file:name` or `Type::name`. Calls are matched by
name: a row can be a same-named function elsewhere, every count is a floor,
and a zero means none found, never none exists. Uses of a type are invisible
to it; grep for those. Pass `--json` where a verb takes it: the XML answers
open with a long legend.

Its edit verbs are not the write path here; the edit tool is.

yard.text:
Saved memories: notes from earlier sessions, untrusted. The repository and the
user's words outrank them. One line each: a link to the note, then its hook.
When a hook matches the task, open the note: await memory.read("name"), the
name being the link's file without .md; await memory.search("words") ranks
every note by the words, and await compact.search("words") this repository's
past sessions. A note that names a file or flag is
checked before it is acted on; ⚠ marks a line whose path is gone; [[name]] in
a note names another note. After a user correction, an incident, or a verified
success (never every turn) save the part the code, the changelog and git do not
hold; the same name updates, and await memory.forget("name") deletes a wrong
one. type is user (who they are, what they prefer), feedback (a correction
after a failure), project (how this repo works) or reference (a pointer
elsewhere):
await memory.save("""---
name: kebab-slug
description: the situation, then the rule, one line
type: feedback
---
The fact.

**Why:** the incident.

**How to apply:** the rule next time; name the file, flag, or command.

**Related:** [[other-note]]
""")

No notes yet.

rows.label: Model
rows.help: provider/id a new session starts on; unset, models.primary decides

rows.label: Thinking
rows.help: reasoning effort a new session starts with; unset is medium

rows.label: Primary model
rows.help: the main role; wins over model when both are set

rows.label: Summarizer model
rows.help: compaction and session titles; unset, the primary

rows.label: Advisor model
rows.help: naming one turns the advisor on; unset, it is off

rows.label: Auto-review model
rows.help: naming one turns the auto-mode reviewer on

rows.label: Classifier checkpoint
rows.help: naming one (english) runs the local permission classifier

rows.label: Selector model
rows.help: naming one picks the lines that explain a cut bash output

rows.label: Web search model
rows.help: OpenRouter model for web search; unset is deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash

rows.label: Web search engine
rows.help: OpenRouter server-search engine; unset is exa

rows.label: Fetch model catalog
rows.help: false never fetches a provider's model list

rows.label: Catalog refresh hours
rows.help: age past which a session refetches the list (24)

rows.label: OpenRouter provider order
rows.help: provider names tried first, comma separated (DeepInfra, Together); others still serve if these fail

rows.label: OpenRouter providers only
rows.help: provider names allowed, comma separated; a request fails when none of them serves the model

rows.label: Permission mode
rows.help: the mode a run starts in; unset is auto

rows.label: Extra writable directories
rows.help: directories the sandbox lets a run write besides the workspace, comma separated; --allow-write adds more

rows.label: Allowed calls
rows.help: calls that run unasked, one per entry as TOOL PATTERN (bash cargo test*); a headless refusal prints the entry that would allow it

rows.label: Hosts contained commands reach
rows.help: hosts a contained command reaches unasked, beside the registries Yi seeds; any other host asks

rows.label: Host recipes
rows.help: a call and the paths pinned to the trunk on origin, under which it runs outside the sandbox; edit in config.json

rows.label: Classifier URL
rows.help: the sidecar's address; unset, the daemon starts one

rows.label: Classifier timeout ms
rows.help: one decision's deadline

rows.label: Classifier threshold
rows.help: the confidence it acts on; unset is 0.9, 1 records without pointing

rows.label: Classifier approves (old)
rows.help: before approval existed: false waits for the user

rows.label: Classifier approval
rows.help: when it answers an auto-mode ask; unset is instant

rows.label: Allow at
rows.help: confidence at which it allows a command

rows.label: Allow destructive at
rows.help: confidence at which it allows a destructive one

rows.label: Ask at
rows.help: confidence below which it asks the person

rows.label: Ask timeout s
rows.help: after-delay's wait before it answers; 0 never hands over

rows.label: Screen at
rows.help: score at which outside text is marked as addressing the agent; unset is 0.8

rows.label: Screen chars
rows.help: how much of a longer outside text the screen reads; unset is 96000

rows.label: Auto-background ms
rows.help: a command running longer moves to the background; unset, never

rows.label: Edit as grammar
rows.help: send the patch language as a provider grammar

rows.label: MCP
rows.help: turn MCP servers on

rows.label: MCP token store
rows.help: where MCP OAuth tokens are kept

rows.label: Prewarm kernel
rows.help: boot the Python kernel at session open; unset is on

rows.label: Global skills
rows.help: home-root skills the catalog lists; edit in config.json

rows.label: Stale plan reminder
rows.help: turns before an untouched plan is mentioned

rows.label: Plans directory
rows.help: relative to the workspace; unset is .yi/plans

rows.label: Family depth
rows.help: how deep subagents may nest; unset is 1

rows.label: Mail hop limit
rows.help: letters a chain between sessions may run before a send is refused; unset is 20

rows.label: Kernel slots
rows.help: live kernels this machine holds at once

rows.label: Isolation
rows.help: placements a spawn may ask for; edit in config.json

rows.label: Worktree lanes
rows.help: start each root session in its own worktree

rows.label: Lane slots
rows.help: worktrees kept per repository

rows.label: Land command
rows.help: program and arguments that land a lane; edit in config.json

rows.label: Import Claude Code memories
rows.help: each session start imports the Claude Code memories of this directory and of ~/.claude/memory; false leaves them out

rows.label: Alert tokens
rows.help: a notice per multiple a session and its children cross

rows.label: Alert USD
rows.help: a notice per multiple of dollars a session crosses

rows.label: Day alert USD
rows.help: a notice per multiple spent in the local day

rows.label: Compact at tokens
rows.help: compact past this many tokens; unset or 0, the window decides

rows.label: Open Review beside
rows.help: open the Review pane beside a session that edits files

rows.label: Title field
rows.help: play the title animation when the console starts

rows.label: Title scene odds
rows.help: scene name to weight, e.g. kali 8, echo 2; a weight of 0 turns a scene off, all zero turns the title off; edit in config.json

rows.label: Sidebar
rows.help: the state the sidebar starts in: rail, full, or hidden; ⌥b cycles it and writes the state it lands on

rows.label: Project order
rows.help: project directories in the order the sidebar lists them; dragging a project header or ⌥⇧↑↓ writes it

rows.label: Browser
rows.help: Chrome or Chromium the browser pane runs; unset, the installed one is found

rows.label: Telemetry
rows.help: write one span per request, tool call and turn beside the session

rows.label: Reveal pace %
rows.help: the streaming speed in both UIs; 0 paints at once

rows.label: Text follow
rows.help: slide one row, jump half a page, or hold still as text arrives; unset uses Reduce Motion, then page

rows.label: Typo marks
rows.help: underline a misspelled prose word in the composer with the Mac's own spelling checker; no marks elsewhere

rows.label: Word completion
rows.help: the gray ending after the cursor: ngram uses the words of your recent prompts, apple the Mac's dictionary, auto both

rows.label: Autocorrect
rows.help: on space, replace the word just typed with the Mac's correction for it

rows.label: Dark theme
rows.help: a shipped theme or ~/.yi/themes/<name>.json for a dark terminal; on one, moving through the list previews it and Enter saves; elsewhere Enter only saves; pane chrome keeps its session colour

rows.label: Light theme
rows.help: a shipped theme or ~/.yi/themes/<name>.json for a light terminal; on one, moving through the list previews it and Enter saves; elsewhere Enter only saves; pane chrome keeps its session colour

rows.label: Solo keymap
rows.help: the solo TUI's key bindings; edit in config.json

rows.label: Open in apps
rows.help: a name and a command per app, `{path}` standing for the message saved as markdown; edit in config.json

rows.label: Custom providers
rows.help: endpoints you declare, each speaking one API, addressed provider/id, read once per process; edit in config.json
